name: B2BKit – Complete WooCommerce Wholesale, B2B, RFQ & Dynamic Pricing Suite
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
B2BKit by DominoPress is not just another simple wholesale pricing plugin. It is a complete Enterprise B2B Commerce Operating System built natively for WooCommerce.

Whether you are building a wholesale store, distributor portal, manufacturer store, dealer/reseller portal, B2B + B2C hybrid store, corporate procurement portal, RFQ/quotation platform, or an enterprise customer portal, B2BKit provides the deeply integrated tools you need.

Designed with a modular, highly performant PHP architecture, B2BKit seamlessly overlays onto your existing WooCommerce store, allowing you to run complex B2B operations alongside your standard retail (B2C) operations.

🚀 Core Features & Modules

1. The Turing-Complete Rule Engine

At the heart of B2BKit is a deeply powerful, custom-built Rule Engine. Instead of rigid toggles, you can build dynamic, conditional rules to control every aspect of your store.
* Conditions: Build rules based on Company ID, User Role, Department, Cart Subtotal, Specific Products/Categories, and more.
* Actions: Apply percentage discounts, fixed price overrides, hide products, enforce minimum order quantities (MOQ), or trigger approval workflows.

2. Advanced B2B Pricing & Catalog Visibility

Take absolute control over what your customers see and what they pay.
* Tiered Pricing: Set bulk discounts (e.g., Buy 10-49 for $5, Buy 50+ for $4).
* Company-Specific Contracts: Assign highly specific, negotiated pricing contracts to individual companies.
* Catalog Hiding: Hide entire categories or specific products from guest users, retail users, or specific B2B companies.
* MOQ & MOV: Enforce Minimum Order Quantities per product and Minimum Order Values per cart before checkout is permitted.

3. B2B Companies & Departments

B2B commerce involves organizations, not just individual users.
* Company Accounts: Group multiple WordPress users under a single master Company Account.
* Department Hierarchies: Assign employees to specific departments within a company (e.g., Marketing, IT, Purchasing).
* Budgets: Set rolling monthly spending budgets for specific employees or departments.

4. RFQ, Quote Cart & Negotiation

Allow enterprise clients to negotiate prices instead of forcing them through a standard cart.
* Add to Quote: Dynamically replace “Add to Cart” buttons with “Add to Quote” buttons based on your Rule Engine logic.
* Quote Cart: A dedicated frontend interface where buyers can stage products and submit a Request for Quote (RFQ).
* Quote Manager Dashboard: A robust admin UI to review incoming quotes, adjust unit prices, and send counter-offers.
* B2B Messaging Center: A threaded, real-time AJAX messaging system attached directly to quotes for seamless buyer-seller negotiation.

5. Procurement & Approval Workflows

Mirror corporate purchasing hierarchies directly inside WooCommerce.
* Purchase Order (PO) Gateway: A native WooCommerce payment gateway that forces buyers to enter a PO Number at checkout.
* Manager Approvals: If an employee exceeds their assigned budget, or if a strict rule applies, the checkout is intercepted. The order is placed “On Hold” (wc-pending-approval) until the Company Manager approves it via their frontend dashboard.

6. B2B Financial Ledger (Credit Limits & Terms)

Manage complex B2B payment terms without needing external software.
* Pay on Credit Gateway: Allow trusted companies to check out using an assigned credit line. The system automatically hard-blocks transactions that exceed their available balance.
* Automated Ledgers: All credit purchases automatically debit the company account and log a transaction in the B2BKit ledger.
* Payment Terms: Assign Net-15, Net-30, Net-60 terms to companies.
* Automated Invoicing: Orders placed on Credit or PO automatically generate a formal B2B invoice with a perfectly calculated Due Date.

7. Sales Representatives & CRM

Bridge the gap between your sales team and your buyers.
* Sales Rep Role: A custom WordPress user role (b2bkit_sales_rep) with restricted permissions.
* Company Assignment: Assign Sales Reps to specific companies.
* CRM Data Isolation: Sales Reps get a dedicated backend CRM dashboard. Strict database isolation ensures they can only see orders and quotes from the companies assigned to them.
* Commission Attribution: Orders placed by a company are automatically tagged with their assigned Sales Rep’s ID.

8. Analytics & PDF Document Generation

Keep your finger on the pulse of your B2B operations.
* B2B Dashboard: A custom analytics screen that filters out retail sales, showing you pure B2B gross volume, outstanding credit debt, and pending quote pipelines.
* 1-Click PDF Generation: High-performance, unstyled HTML-to-Print endpoints allow users to instantly generate beautiful, printable PDFs of their Quotes, Invoices, and Price Lists without bloating your server.

9. Developer-Friendly REST API

Integrate B2BKit with your existing enterprise software (SAP, NetSuite, Salesforce).
* Native WordPress REST API: Inherits WordPress’s robust authentication (Cookie, Application Passwords).
* Company Endpoints: Read company profiles and real-time credit balances via /wp-json/b2bkit/v1/companies.
* Credit Management: Programmatically replenish credit limits via external ERPs when off-platform wire transfers clear.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the b2bkit-advanced-wholesale-suite-by-dominopress folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is active.
  4. Navigate to B2BKit -> Settings to begin configuring your Rule Engine and Company accounts.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce to run B2BKit?

Yes, B2BKit is built as a highly advanced extension of the WooCommerce core e-commerce engine.

Can I run a retail (B2C) store alongside my B2B store?

Absolutely. B2BKit’s Rule Engine allows you to create rules that only apply to logged-in B2B companies, leaving your retail prices and “Add to Cart” buttons perfectly intact for standard guests.

How do I assign a Sales Rep to a Company?

Create a WordPress user and assign them the “B2B Sales Representative” role. Then, edit a Company profile in the B2BKit backend and select the user from the Sales Rep dropdown.

Does this plugin generate heavy PDF files on my server?

No! To keep your site lightning-fast, we built a modern HTML-to-Print engine. Clicking “Download PDF” loads a clean, brandable HTML page that automatically triggers the browser’s native, highly-optimized “Save as PDF” engine.
